# NodeExecutionException

common

@[ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html)

open class [NodeExecutionException](index.html)(val typeName: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), message: [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html), cause: [Throwable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-throwable/index.html)? = null) : [RuntimeException](https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/java/lang/RuntimeException.html)
